title: Hybrid Strength
subtitle: Pull-Up + HSPU × traditional strength · 12 weeks
progression_rules: Pull-Up and HSPU never go to technical failure.
Main weights stay around 1–2 RIR; deloads 3–4 RIR.
HSPU: progress only after two clean sessions at the current variation.
Weighted Pull-Up: only when you own roughly 6 clean bodyweight reps.
If recovery drops, cut optional accessories and HIIT volume before Pull-Up/HSPU skill work.
hybrid_logic: Calisthenics is the skill layer; weights build the engine. Monday prioritises vertical pull + hinge. Tuesday prioritises HSPU/vertical press + squat. Wednesday keeps conditioning and mobility together. Thursday is exploratory skill work. Friday builds full-body strength and auto-regulates around Thursday fatigue.

weighted_pull_up.basis: Maximum of current and previous week logged max clean pull-ups
weighted_pull_up.below_6_if_logged: Use bodyweight 4×4–6 (or assisted 4×6) instead of adding weight.
weighted_pull_up.at_least_6: Weighted work is appropriate if technique stays strict.

friday_after_heavy_thursday.pull: Row: reduce to 1–2 easy sets or skip.
friday_after_heavy_thursday.push: Bench: reduce to 1–2 easy sets or skip.
friday_after_heavy_thursday.legs: Squat/Bulgarian: reduce volume; Bulgarian work can be skipped.

Monday.prescription: Dead hang 2×25s · scapular pull-up 2×8 · band straight-arm pulldown 1×15
Monday.note: Prime shoulders and scapulae without fatigue.
*Only use added weight once you own ~6 clean bodyweight reps. Otherwise use bodyweight 4×4–6 or assisted 4×6.
No momentum; chest stays planted.
1–2 RIR; hinge cleanly, do not chase fatigue.
Different stimulus from pull-ups; stop short of failure.
Drop first when time or recovery is poor.

Tuesday.prescription: Wrist rocks · scap push-ups · wall slides · shoulder CARs
Tuesday.note: Prepare wrists and overhead position.
Stay fresh; this is practice, not conditioning.
Advance only after two clean sessions at the current progression.
Build the vertical-press engine for HSPU; 1–2 RIR.
Horizontal pressing strength; use weighted dips in a later block if preferred.
Strong controlled reps; 1–2 RIR.
Optional if session exceeds 50 min.

Wednesday.note: Genuinely hard but controlled. Keep grip/lats fresh for Thursday.

Wednesday.prescription: Wrist rocks 2×10 · wall flexion 2×8 · wall slides 2×10 · bench lat stretch 2×40s

Thursday.prescription: Normal class; self-regulate and avoid unnecessary failure
Thursday.note: Priority: Pull-Up → HSPU/Handstand → general skills. Enjoy other skills without turning them into extra goals.

Thursday.prescription: Record whether class was heavy on PULL / PUSH / LEGS
Thursday.note: These toggles automatically modify Friday guidance.

Friday.prescription: 5 min easy bike + squat/press/row ramp-up sets
Friday.note: No fatigue; just prepare the patterns.
Main Friday lower-body strength. If Thursday legs were heavy: reduce to 2 easy sets.
If Thursday push was heavy: reduce to 1–2 easy sets or skip.
If Thursday pull was heavy: reduce to 1–2 easy sets or skip.
If Thursday legs were heavy: skip.
Scapular/rear-delt health.
Optional; choose one and rotate as desired.
